uncited: **Ray-Box Intersection:** Determine the entry point $t_{in}$ and exit point $t_{out}$ of the viewing ray within the volume bounding box.
**Viewing Ray Sampling:** Iterate along the viewing ray from $t_{in}$ to $t_{out}$ with a fixed step size $\Delta t$.
**Light Ray Intersection:** For each sample point $\mathbf{x}$, cast a secondary ray towards the light source and determine its intersection bounds $[t_{light, in}, t_{light, out}]$ with the volume.
**Transmittance Calculation:** Compute the optical depth $\tau$ along the secondary ray from $\mathbf{x}$ to the light source (or until it exits the volume).
**Scattering Integration:** Compute the differential contribution $\Delta L = \rho(\mathbf{x}) \cdot T_{\text{light}} \cdot p(\cos \theta) \cdot \Delta t$.
**Accumulation:** Sum the contributions from all sample points along the viewing ray to obtain $L$.
